summary: Full backend + frontend testing of 'Anında Teklif' Turkish quote generator app. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passing across Company/Catalog/Customer/Quote CRUD, server-side totals computation, PATCH status, bulk catalog import, customer auto-upsert on quote save, cascade delete, and MongoDB _id leak protection. Frontend: All 5 bottom tabs navigate correctly (Teklif/Katalog/Geçmiş/Müşteri/Firma). App auto-seeds SKYART GROUP GÖLGELENDİRME company on first load. Top header shows 'Anında Teklif' brand + screen subtitle. Editor live-computes totals with iskonto/KDV, currency chips (USD/EUR/TRY) switch correctly, add-blank-item and item field editing works. End-to-end save flow verified: filled form → tapped 'Kaydet & PDF İndir/Paylaş' → quote persisted to backend (540$ = 3×150 + 20% KDV) → appears in Geçmiş tab with status 'Beklemede' and Düzenle/PDF/WhatsApp/Delete actions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via projection ({'_id': 0}) on all list/get; validated no ObjectId leaks in responses.
compute_totals() is server-authoritative and matches frontend live calc (verified 3*150 -> 450 subtotal, 540 genelToplam with %20 KDV).
Customer auto-upsert on quote create (POST /api/quotes) works and prevents duplicates (matches by companyId+firma).
Cascade delete on DELETE /api/companies/{id} correctly removes catalog/customers/quotes.

One minor React Native Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — non-blocking, coming from a third-party lib (likely Ionicons/expo internals); no action needed.
seed_data_creation: Frontend auto-seeded 'SKYART GROUP GÖLGELENDİRME' company on first boot as expected. Backend test suite created TEST_-prefixed companies/catalog/customers/quotes and cleaned up via cascade delete fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is fully functional. Backend base URL: https://app-genesis-52.preview.emergentagent.com. Use `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_aninda_teklif.py` for regression. All 5 tabs work — navigate via bottom tab bar coordinates (y≈818, x=39/117/195/273/351 for 390px viewport). testIDs present for critical elements: mus-firma-input, add-blank-btn, item-name-{n}, item-qty-{n}, item-price-{n}, cur-USD/EUR/TRY, pdf-download-btn, whatsapp-share-btn, add-company-btn, save-company-btn, grand-total-banner. Note: expo-sharing on web only downloads PDF (no native share sheet) — this is expected. expo-image-picker for logo upload not testable on web preview.
